tagline: Wavetable electric piano with Rhodes, Wurlitzer and hybrid tones
description: A 16-voice electric piano that plays fixed single-cycle wavetables, with a velocity curve, a tone low-pass and per-voice tremolo. Notes hold at a steady level while the key is down and fade after release at a rate set by Decay. The sound is synthesized from wavetables, not modelled or sampled.

features.name: Model
features.description: Rhodes, Wurlitzer, or Hybrid (a 50/50 blend of the two) wavetables.

features.name: Velocity Curve
features.description: Reshapes velocity with a power curve: squared at 0, square root at 0.5 and linear at 1.

features.name: Tone and Decay
features.description: Tone blends in a one-pole low-pass for a darker sound; Decay sets how long notes take to fade after key-up.

features.name: Tremolo
features.description: Amplitude tremolo of up to plus or minus 50% at 0.1-20 Hz.

features.name: Chorus, Reverb and Output Level
features.description: Chorus and Reverb are a one-sample delay blend and a one-pole blend that mostly soften the tone; Output Level runs from -24 to +12 dB.
